xuhui-nanyang-campus-gate-preview.png.observation: The street opening, plaque, two separate guardians, green roof, curled ridge terminals and full silhouette are in view.

east-painted-gate.png.observation: The four black characters form a separate vertical white plaque beside the covered passage. The close view shows red wall and column, ochre and turquoise fields and the rhythm of rolled roof tiles.

stone-guardian.png.observation: The seated guardian is separate from the gate. The opening at the jaw, paw placement, mane and stepped pedestal are visible.

campus-reverse.png.observation: The red-framed rows of windows flank the central campus opening. Both grey plinths and the continuous roof are visible.

viewer-desktop-full.png.observation: The light stone guardians and green ridge are legible in the full-width viewer.

viewer-mobile-lod.png.observation: The complete eastern elevation fits in the model viewport above the narrow-screen controls.
